// Projects

Proven on the region's biggest stages

A selection from our delivery record across the UAE and Saudi Arabia.

2021–2022

Farnek (via EXPO 2020 Dubai)

EXPO 2020 Dubai — Pavilion Technology & Projection Mapping

Six months of continuous operations at the world expo as IT Engineer with Farnek: delivering and sustaining 18 projection mapping installations alongside interactive touch, motion-activated, laser and PCB-controlled experiences — all running on event-grade infrastructure with enterprise uptime expectations.

2022

AD360, Abu Dhabi

ADNEC Arena 360 — Fan-Zone Interactive Experiences

High-energy audience interactivity for a major sports entertainment destination: an interactive trampoline, an interactive climbing wall and a 360 photo booth — engineered for thousands of daily participants with zero show-day downtime targets.

2022

New York University Abu Dhabi

NYU Abu Dhabi — Interactive Event Technology

Interactive event technology deployment for academic and cultural programming at NYUAD, blending immersive visuals with reliable campus-network integration and accessibility-conscious interaction design.

// Why Secure Media Tech

Security pedigree.
Show-floor craft.

Most agencies choose a lane. We were forced into both: running national-scale security governance as an Information Security Associate Manager by day, and keeping eighteen projection rigs alive through a six-month world expo as IT Engineer by night.

The result is technology that is simultaneously spectacular and defensible — experiences auditors don't fear, and infrastructure marketers actually love.

CEH & CHFI-certified offensive security practice

CISSP-track governance and compliance leadership

Splunk · QRadar · LogRhythm SIEM engineering

Cisco CCNA networking through BGP/MPLS/QoS depth

Azure & AWS cloud integration

AI systems with human-in-the-loop guardrails
